What topics are covered in Strategic Marketing for Africa?

Strategic Marketing for Africa provides credible, coherent, and courageous editorial coverage on all matters related to marketing and its associated professions. The publication explores macro-economic shifts, digital transformation, retail evolution, and market research, evaluating global and regional commercial strategies from an unapologetically African perspective.

Who writes the articles for the Strategic Marketing for Africa magazine?

The magazine features a diverse array of high-calibre contributors rather than relying on a single author or in-house team. The editorial content is carefully curated and edited together, drawing on the expertise of industry leaders, strategic consultants, academic researchers, and experienced practitioners to provide authoritative insights across the continent.

How much does it cost to read Strategic Marketing for Africa?

Strategic Marketing for Africa is entirely free to access. Readers can choose to read the interactive digital edition online or download the full publication as a PDF directly from the African Marketing Confederation website without a paywall or subscription fee.

When was the Strategic Marketing for Africa journal first published?

The journal has been published in various formats since 2008. Over more than 15 years, it has continuously evolved to serve as the definitive thought-leadership platform for Africa’s marketing and business communities.

Is Strategic Marketing for Africa only for marketing professionals?

The publication is designed for marketing professionals, business executives, brand strategists, supply chain leaders, and academic researchers. It delivers the high-level market intelligence and commercial capability required by decision-makers operating within Africa's dynamic business environments.
